claim: For the pinned built-in Lens catalog producer and unchanged fixed definition/adapter sources, batch private construction preserves canonical returned catalogs, public admission/refusal results and tested source-retaining view semantics while reducing measured warm construction/export/replay cost on two frozen libraries. No whole-factory speed or universal asymptotic/crossover claim.

assurance_preservation.analysis: No new state/cache/interface/dependency. Every completed catalog still crosses validate_registry; public register, validators and exact canonical adapter matching are unchanged. Definition constructors deep-copy mutable fields and new ownership tests exercise this. The same finite/structural checker bodies reconstruct and check fresh applications. Shared source implementation hashes deliberately change, invalidating old receipts; current receipts are regenerated/replayed, not transferred. Existing trust in Python, filesystem source identity and selected checker is retained; no kernel proof, bytecode attestation, effect authority, deployment or full2.7 claim.
open_questions: Native checker/runtime-isolation/end-to-end refinement obligations remain separate.
